description: This Java class 'SearchModelFactory' serves as a factory utility for creating and manipulating search-related objects such as SearchResult, SearchFilter, SearchProperty, SearchQuery, and various options like SortOption, LimitOption, SizeOption, and CursorOption. It provides static methods that facilitate building and combining search filters, creating search properties, and assembling search queries for a model likely related to a search or filter mechanism within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: SearchModelFactory
classes.description: A final utility class providing static factory methods for creating and combining search-related objects such as search results, filters, properties, queries, and options within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: newSearchResult
methods.description: Creates a new SearchResult instance from a JsonArray of items and a page offset, returning an immutable SearchResult.

methods.name: emptySearchResult
methods.description: Returns an immutable empty SearchResult instance.

methods.name: newSearchResult
methods.description: Creates a new SearchResult initialized from a provided JsonObject.

methods.name: newSearchResult
methods.description: Creates a new SearchResult from a JSON string representing a JsonObject.

methods.name: newSearchResultBuilder
methods.description: Returns a new builder for constructing SearchResult objects.

methods.name: newSearchResultBuilder
methods.description: Returns a builder initialized with the properties of an existing SearchResult.

methods.name: and
methods.description: Creates a LogicalSearchFilter that combines given filters using the AND operator.

methods.name: or
methods.description: Creates a LogicalSearchFilter that combines given filters using the OR operator.

methods.name: not
methods.description: Creates a LogicalSearchFilter that negates the given filter with the NOT operator.

methods.name: property
methods.description: Creates a SearchProperty object for a given JsonPointer path.

methods.name: property
methods.description: Creates a SearchProperty object for a given property path string.

methods.name: newSearchQuery
methods.description: Creates a SearchQuery based on the given SearchFilter.

methods.name: newSearchQueryBuilder
methods.description: Returns a builder for creating an immutable SearchQuery with a given filter.

methods.name: newSortOption
methods.description: Creates a SortOption with multiple entries from a list of SortOptionEntry.

methods.name: newSortOption
methods.description: Creates a SortOption with a single entry for the specified property path and order.

methods.name: newSortOptionEntry
methods.description: Creates a SortOptionEntry with the specified property path and sort order.

methods.name: newSortOptionEntry
methods.description: Deprecated method to create a SortOptionEntry; use the non-deprecated version instead.

methods.name: newLimitOption
methods.description: Creates a LimitOption for pagination with specified offset and count.

methods.name: newSizeOption
methods.description: Creates a SizeOption with the specified maximum result size.

methods.name: newCursorOption
methods.description: Creates a CursorOption with the given cursor string.
